name: Abishua
overview: The name Abishua appears in Scripture as both a descendant of Aaron and a son of Bela, highlighting distinct individuals bearing this name. In the priestly lineage, Abishua is noted as the son of Phinehas and the grandson of Eleazar, serving as a high priest in the line of Aaron, as seen in 1 Chronicles 6:4-5 and 6:50. Additionally, 1 Chronicles 8:4 lists Abishua among the sons of Bela, emphasizing his role within a different tribal genealogy. These references collectively affirm Abishua's importance in Israel's priestly and tribal histories.
